steps.title: Nginx Reverse Proxy & Round-Robin Load Balancer
steps.description: Configure an Nginx load balancer upstream pooling 3 backend microservice nodes with health check timeouts and weighted round-robin distribution.
tasks: Define `upstream backend_cluster` containing `server 10.0.1.10:8080 weight=3;`, `server 10.0.1.11:8080;`, and `server 10.0.1.12:8080 backup;`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/scalability/nginx_lb.conf && grep -q 'upstream backend_cluster' /home/student/scalability/nginx_lb.conf && grep -q 'proxy_pass' /home/student/scalability/nginx_lb.conf && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Distributed Caching & Cache-Control Policies
steps.description: Formulate HTTP caching headers and cache invalidation strategies (Stale-While-Revalidate and Redis TTLs).

verification.command: test -f /home/student/scalability/cache_headers.conf && grep -q 'stale-while-revalidate' /home/student/scalability/cache_headers.conf && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Leaky Bucket Rate Limiting against DDoS
steps.description: Implement rate limiting using Nginx `limit_req_zone` to clamp incoming traffic to 10 requests/sec with a burst buffer of 20 requests.

verification.command: test -f /home/student/scalability/rate_limit.conf && grep -q 'limit_req_zone' /home/student/scalability/rate_limit.conf && grep -q 'burst=20' /home/student/scalability/rate_limit.conf && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Circuit Breaker Pattern against Cascading Outages
steps.description: Write a Python circuit breaker simulation (`circuit_breaker.py`) that trips to OPEN state after 5 consecutive downstream timeouts.
tasks: Write simulation logic that trips the circuit on errors and logs state transitions to `/home/student/scalability/circuit_state.log`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/scalability/circuit_breaker.py && python3 /home/student/scalability/circuit_breaker.py && test -f /home/student/scalability/circuit_state.log && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Active-Passive High Availability & Health Probing
steps.description: Configure keepalived / failover health checks that automatically redirect traffic from Primary Node to Standby Node within 3 seconds of failure.
tasks: Implement automated health probe checking HTTP status code; if non-200, trigger backup switchover
Make executable and verify test execution
